Name: (JA) More Crops
Author: martincudek
Description:
This mod adds:

Carrot
-Plant in spring
-4 days to mature
-Seeds cost 30g
-Crop sells for 70g
-Purchase seeds from Pierre

Cabbage
-Plant in summer 
-7 days to mature
-Seeds cost 70g
-Crop sells for 140g
-Purchase seeds from Pierre

Pure Prisma Berry
-Plant in fall 
-Takes 15 days to mature 
-Seeds cost 1200g
-Crop sells for 2500g
-Purchase seeds from Sandy

Turnip
-Plant in summer
-Takes 4 days to mature
-Seeds cost 30g
-Crops sells for 75g
-Purchase seeds from Pierre

Moonfruit
-Plant in winter
-Takes 13 days to mature
-Seeds cost 250g
-Crop sells for 800g
-Purchase seeds from Sandy

Pear
-Bears fruit in fall
-Takes 28 days to mature
-Sapling costs 4000g
-Crop sells for 110g
-Purchase sapling from Pierre
